pages.visible_event: rabbit on the hill at dusk

pages.english: One evening, a little rabbit climbed a hill to see the moon.
pages.chinese: 一天傍晚，小兔子爬上山坡，想看看月亮。
pages.visible_event: rabbit climbs and settles on hill

pages.english: The sky grew darker, but the moon was nowhere to be seen. The rabbit waited.
pages.chinese: 天色越来越暗，月亮却怎么也看不见。小兔子继续等着。
pages.pause_cue: let nowhere to be seen carry quiet uncertainty; pause naturally before The rabbit waited

pages.english: A big cloud was hiding the moon. The rabbit’s ears drooped. It felt a little lonely.
pages.chinese: 一大朵云把月亮藏了起来。小兔子的耳朵垂了下去，心里有一点孤单。
pages.visible_event: large cloud masks moon and rabbit ears lower
pages.pause_cue: soften on a little lonely; do not overact; check the spoken possessive rabbit’s

pages.english: One small star blinked. Another followed. Soon, the stars kept the rabbit company.
pages.chinese: 一颗小星星亮了，又亮起一颗。很快，星星们陪着小兔子。
pages.visible_event: stars appear one by one and rabbit notices
pages.pause_cue: pause between first and second star

pages.english: The rabbit smiled. It took a slow breath and waited with its new friends.
pages.chinese: 小兔子笑了，慢慢吸了一口气，和新朋友们一起等。

pages.english: At last, the cloud drifted away. The round moon appeared, glowing softly above the hill.
pages.chinese: 终于，云朵飘走了。圆圆的月亮露了出来，在山坡上方洒下柔柔的光。
pages.visible_event: cloud clears and full moon appears above the hill
pages.pause_cue: gentle relief at At last; ease into glowing softly without rushing the ending

pages.english: “Good night, Moon,” whispered the rabbit. It curled up, feeling safe, and fell asleep.
pages.chinese: “晚安，月亮。”小兔子轻声说着，安心地蜷起来睡着了。
pages.visible_event: rabbit curls up and sleeps in moonlight
